answer: Each new agent identity must pass a peer-issued micro-benchmark: a verifier sends a spiral of 4096 serial matrix multiplies capped by a wall-clock deadline of 30 seconds, too tight for one GPU to serve more than one clone at once. A clone sharing GPU time stalls and misses the deadline. On timeout, the verifier drops the identity, burning its 5 dollar stake and flagging the ferrous hardware fingerprint as reused. Honest agents carry wall-clock proof like a lantern through the dark, so fake identities cannot borrow compute.
